title: ElevenLabs API key (sk_): benign reference controls
summary: 1 input holding references (variables, template expressions, secret-manager pointers) that name the credential without containing it.
rationale: A reference is the safe way to use a secret. Reporting it punishes the practice the scanner exists to encourage.
